If you can reply to each item, that would help us decide whether we need an initial technical call.

Hi Laura / team — thanks for the questions and for moving this forward. Quick answers below; happy to expand or hop on a call.

1) SOC 2: Confirmed — attached is our SOC 2 Type II report covering the period Jan 1, 2026 — Dec 31, 2026. Scope includes production inference and control plane services. (See attached SOC2_Report_Redwood_TypeII_2026.pdf)

2) HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA-covered workloads and can sign a BAA. We have an established BAA template we can share; happy to execute with Aurora's legal team.

3) Data residency: By default customer data is stored in the cloud region selected at provisioning. We offer tenant-level residency options (AWS us-east-1 is available in our hosted product) for enterprise customers and for Private deployments we can accommodate stricter residency requirements.

4) Pen testing: We conduct annual third-party pen-tests; we can provide a redacted summary of findings and remediation status. For legal/contractual reasons some raw reports are redacted, but we’ll share what’s appropriate.

5) Questionnaire formats: Yes — we can complete the CAIQ and Aurora's custom vendor form. For efficiency we typically start with the CAIQ (spreadsheet) and then map any custom fields.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached the SOC 2 report and our standard BAA template.
- Please share your CAIQ spreadsheet and custom form; we’ll aim to return a completed CAIQ within 3 business days and confirm timeline for custom items.
- If you'd like a technical walkthrough, I can schedule a 30-min call with one of our security engineers. Proposed times: Tue 2027-05-04 10:00am PT or Wed 2027-05-05 9:00am PT.

Contacts: Marissa Cole (security lead) marissa.cole@redwood.ai; Camila Reyes (AE) camila.reyes@redwood.ai

Best,
